The test image shows a clear field comparison: robust, full-canopy plants on the left vs. severely stunted, sparse, and chlorotic plants on the right (with red markers). This pattern — drastic plant stunting and reduced stands in patches/rows adjacent to healthy plants — is the hallmark of Soybean Cyst Nematode (SCN). The reference collage confirms this with similar field stunting, chlorosis/yellowing, and the distinctive white cysts visible on roots.
